description: This file implements a Python module for interacting with a PostgreSQL database used by the LiteLLM project. It contains a class 'LiteLLMDatabase' with methods for retrieving usage data, table information, discovering tables, and managing database schema details. The code emphasizes database querying, schema introspection, and data extraction using raw SQL via a Prisma client. It is tailored specifically for the LiteLLM application's database structure and data operations.

classes.name: LiteLLMDatabase
classes.description: Main class for managing LiteLLM PostgreSQL database connections and queries, including data retrieval and schema discovery.

methods.name: _ensure_prisma_client(self)
methods.description: Ensures that the Prisma client is available for database operations.

methods.name: pl.DataFrame get_usage_data( self, limit: Optional[int] = None, start_time_utc: Optional[datetime] = None, end_time_utc: Optional[datetime] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves usage data with optional time filtering and limit, returning as a Polars DataFrame.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_table_info(self)
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about the 'LiteLLM_DailyUserSpend' table, including schema and row count.

methods.name: int _get_table_row_count(self, table_name: str)
methods.description: Utility method to get row count for a specified table.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] discover_all_tables(self)
methods.description: Discovers all tables in the LiteLLM database matching a naming pattern, retrieving schema, primary keys, foreign keys, indexes, and row counts.
